reason: An explicit DSH profile bundle that fetches Qwen-MM capabilities, launches their MCP servers, and exposes the resulting tools and skills, with optional browser rendering for image outputs.

summaries.zh: 一个将 Qwen-MM 能力以 DSH 配置包形式接入的插件，用于获取能力源、启动 MCP 服务并向模型提供对应工具与技能。
summaries.en: A DSH profile bundle that fetches Qwen-MM capabilities, starts their MCP servers, and exposes the resulting tools and skills to the model.

capabilities: Fetches selected upstream capability sources with Git at a pinned reference
Starts external MCP processes using configurable commands, arguments, environment, and working directory
Registers discovered MCP tools and paired agent skills with DSH
Provides browser rendering for image-related result references
